0x19ab453c.notice: Runs the access-control + reentrancy-guard + Stargate-adapter initializers. MUST be invoked via the diamond's `initialize` `_init` delegatecall.

params.admin: The address granted `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` (controls every adapter setter).

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for a Stargate v2 token-bridge diamond — seeds AccessControl (so the chainId ⇄ eid and per-token pool registrations are `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`-gated), the reentrancy guard (the send path is `nonReentrant`), and registers the IStargateBridgeAdapter interface via ERC-165. No protocol addresses are wired at init: Stargate is per-token pools, all registered by the admin AFTER deploy ({registerEid}/{registerPool}, or via the ChainRegistry `addEvmChain` fan-out for the eid map). Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer; each `__*_init` guard passes because the window is already open).
